id: subchart-postgres-internal
name: "Internal postgres subchart enabled"
description: "Product chart bundles postgres via subchart; verify both come up together."
labels: {profile: full-stack}
cluster:
  provider: kind
  k8s_version: v1.30.0
product:
  chart: ./chart
  release: sample
  namespace: sample
  set:
    postgres.enabled: "true"
  subcharts: {postgres: internal}
asserts:
  - {type: helm-status-deployed, release: sample, namespace: sample}
  - {type: pods-ready, namespace: sample, timeout: 4m}
tags: [pr-subset, nightly]
mechanisms: ['subchart:postgres-internal']
